shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/mempal-memory/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- root ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "react-datepicker DatePicker timeZone timezone selectedDates calendar day highlighting input formatting selectsMultiple" --json --top-k 5'

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "timeZone|timezone|selectedDates|isSelected|formatDate|onChange" src/index.tsx src/calendar.tsx src/day.tsx src/date_utils.ts src/month.tsx src/test/timezone_test.test.tsx src/test/multiple_selected_dates.test.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,130p' src/day.tsx; rg -n \"isSameDay|handleDayClick|onDayClick|selectedDates|selected:\" src/day.tsx src/month.tsx src/week.tsx src/calendar.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"<Calendar|calendarProps|safeDateRangeFormat|formatInTimeZone|this\\.props\\.timeZone\" src/index.tsx; sed -n '1940,2160p' src/index.tsx; sed -n '1060,1185p' src/calendar.tsx; sed -n '180,290p' src/day.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"function newDate|export function newDate|safeDateRangeFormat|safeMultipleDatesFormat\" src/date_utils.ts; sed -n '330,390p' src/date_utils.ts; sed -n '445,560p' src/date_utils.ts; rg -n \"setSelected =|handleTimeChange =|setPreSelection\" src/index.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '260,315p' src/date_utils.ts; sed -n '380,420p' src/index.tsx; sed -n '1050,1240p' src/index.tsx; sed -n '1240,1310p' src/index.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/react-datepicker-timezone-calendar.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Keep timezone calendar dates separate from instants

Date-fns-tz's zoned Date uses a timestamp whose UTC fields represent the target zone's wall-clock fields, but calendar operations in a browser use local getters. Materialize those UTC fields into a local calendar Date for rendering and comparisons, then convert calendar selections back to instants only at public callbacks. Input formatting should use the same target-zone calendar representation so selection, highlighting, and display share one date domain.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && nl -ba src/date_utils.ts | sed -n '145,190p' && nl -ba src/index.tsx | sed -n '525,585p' && nl -ba src/index.tsx | sed -n '1748,1810p'"
